ruleDefinitions.name: Shell Invocation via Env Command - Linux
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the use of the env command to invoke a shell. This may indicate an attempt to bypass restricted environments, escalate privileges, or execute arbitrary commands.

sequences.query: (process_path = RGX("\\/env$") AND (process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/bash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/dash$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/fish$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/sh$") OR process_command_line = RGX("\\/bin\\/zsh$")))
